english.meaning: the stone or seed of a fruit
english.note: 荔枝核 means lychee stone; 細核 means a small stone.

exampleSentences.english: Nuo Mi Ci lychees aren’t sour at all—just sweet, with small pits and lots of flesh.
exampleSentences.traditional: 糯米糍直程冇酸味啊。直程甜又細核又有好肉。

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, but it’s not very big—not as big as a lychee. Anyway, it has a fairly large pit; the rest is medium-sized.
